question: For genres with more than 100 tracks, what is the average track length in minutes for each?
sql:
SELECT
    g.Name AS Genre,
    AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS AvgLengthMinutes
FROM
    Track t
JOIN
    Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY
    g.GenreId, g.Name
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 100;
